Create a DuckDB Out-of-Core Spatial Query Index (gl_duckdb_index)

Source: R/duckdb.R
gl_duckdb_index.Rd

Wraps a DuckDB connection + table, SQL query, or .parquet file so glmap can push bounding-box and SQL filter queries down to DuckDB on the fly.

Usage

gl_duckdb_index(
  con = NULL,
  source,
  lon = "lon",
  lat = "lat",
  color_col = NULL,
  color_fixed = "#00d4ff",
  palette = "viridis",
  opacity = 0.85,
  rad_col = NULL,
  rad_fixed = 4,
  where = NULL,
  max_features = 100000L
)

Arguments

con

A DBIConnection (DuckDB), or NULL if source is a .parquet/.csv file path or data.frame.

source

A table name, SQL SELECT query, .parquet file path, or data.frame to register in DuckDB.

lon

Name of the longitude column (default "lon").

lat

Name of the latitude column (default "lat").

color_col

Optional column name for color mapping.

color_fixed

Fixed hex color when color_col is NULL.

palette

Color palette name ("viridis", "plasma", "turbo", "magma", etc.).

opacity

Point opacity (0 to 1).

rad_col

Optional column name for radius mapping.

rad_fixed

Fixed numeric radius when rad_col is NULL.

where

Optional SQL WHERE filter predicate string (e.g., "intensity > 50 AND category = 'Sensor'").

max_features

Maximum features streamed per viewport frame (default 100000L).

Value

A gl_duckdb_index object.
